spec.data_source: Microsoft Graph native directory roleDefinitions, roleAssignments, roleAssignmentSchedules and roleEligibilitySchedules under the same verified tenant.
spec.predicate: A current assignment or unexpired/future assignment or eligibility schedule declares a principal and scope for the exact custom Entra role. A current custom Entra role has no declared consumer in the complete native directory role assignments and PIM assignment and eligibility schedule inventories.
spec.title: Custom Entra role has declared assignment or PIM consumers
spec.description: Reviews current custom Entra role definitions for declared consumers through directory role assignments and PIM assignment or eligibility schedules. Complete unfiltered paginated sources from the same verified tenant and capture are required before absence can fail. Future and unexpired PIM consumers count, while expired, canceled, denied, failed or revoked schedules do not. Missing or contradictory lifetime evidence remains unresolved. Permission declarations and exact principal scopes are retained. This structural cleanup review does not establish permission-use history, business approval or safe deletion; Azure Resource Manager roles are a separate inventory.
spec.remediation_hint: Review role ownership, intended assignments and pending requests before removing an obsolete custom Entra role.

description.pass_when: A current assignment or unexpired/future assignment or eligibility schedule declares a principal and scope for the exact custom Entra role.
description.fail_when: A current custom Entra role has no declared consumer in the complete native directory role assignments and PIM assignment and eligibility schedule inventories.
description.not_applicable_when: Microsoft built-in role definitions. Missing, denied, filtered, partial or inconsistent assignment and PIM evidence remains UNKNOWN or DENIED.
